Title: HBase accelerated writes in Azure HDInsight is now in preview

Body.Content:
Now in preview, the HBase accelerated writes feature significantly improves the value proposition for low-latency, high-throughput NoSQL workloads. It also improves performance while writing to HBase and helps eliminate data loss by implementing WAL drain mechanisms. 

Learn more
